d:
USA brought an incredible lineup to the 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup, featuring stars like Stephen Curry, James Harden and Anthony Davis!
But Ukraine came ready to compete! Despite facing a loaded USA squad, Ukraine kept competing.
USA secured a 95-71 victory, but Ukraine showed plenty of fight against one of the most talented teams in the tournament!
Watch the BEST moments from USA vs Ukraine at the 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup!
